records.candidate_name_status: Geographic research lead; documented source usages are not a verified full-polygon identity.
records.directly_supported_name_forms_scope: The forms occur in separate English and French water-management bodies. This records their actual usage, not formal bilingual equivalence, jurisdictional naming status or complete-polygon applicability.
records.supported_name_scope: English and French name usage is established in basin context. Insufficient detailed official cartography was acquired to connect those usages to every part of the selected inventory polygon.
correspondence_observations: All 62 ordered source positions and all 62 baseline positions, including the closing position, were considered. The polygon has a northwestern arm, a broader northeastern lobe, an elongated central reach and a long southeastern/downstream extension.

The northern perimeter reaches approximately 47.578188°N, the western arm approximately 79.655812°W, and the downstream endpoint approximately 46.827265°N, 79.156129°W. These are generalized inventory limits, not an official lake-boundary definition.
The ORRPB map places numbered reservoir 4 on the western part of the Ottawa River basin, and its table calls that reservoir Timiskaming. This supports regional context only.

The small basin schematic does not resolve the two northern arms, detailed eastern shore or the downstream endpoint against the full polygon. No full-feature correspondence or exhaustive constituent-water assessment can be completed from it.
records.water_management_context: ORRPB describes Timiskaming among the principal reservoirs of the Ottawa River basin. This contextual reservoir usage does not establish a distinct additional waterbody or a formal boundary.
name_scope_limits: The inventory name lake-173 is generic and supplies no naming evidence.
No formal naming instrument or registry record was acquired. No official-status date, jurisdiction-specific form or unsourced alias is asserted.

The full inventory outline was inspected, but whole-feature map correspondence remains pending. The northern arms, eastern limits and downstream termination cannot be resolved on the acquired schematic.
No conclusion is reached on whether a compound named-waterbody finding would be necessary.
records.follow_up_scope: Acquire a permitted independent official map detailed enough to cover the whole selected polygon, including both northern arms, eastern shore and downstream endpoint, before resolving complete named-waterbody scope.

publication_scope: Official bibliographic references and own factual observations only; no raw publications, map derivatives or omitted-source fingerprints.
recorded_review_scope: The complete source and baseline polygon and an acquired basin schematic were inspected. Whole-feature correspondence remains pending due to insufficient cartographic detail.
included_evidence_limit: Included records contain official bibliographic references and own factual observations. Original publications and inspection materials are not included. Public offline checks do not reproduce visual map judgments.
